(C) Raising up, throwing down, and removing or rejecting. One who sees not offering person, says him a donor for flattering. (3) Raising. Lifting up.

ukkhepanīyakamma: [Ukkhepanīya+kamma]  CL=7 Ukkhepanīyakamma refers to the formal legal action (vinayakamma) of suspending a bhikkhu from the sangha community. This action is taken against a bhikkhu who: fails to acknowledge or rectify an offense, refuses to abandon a wrong view, such as the one held by the Ariṭṭha bhikkhu, commits a serious violation, engages in inappropriate actions such as giving or receiving material requisites (āmisa), studying or teaching scriptures, worshipping, or extending hospitality. The suspended bhikkhu is prohibited from participating in communal activities with other members of the sangha, ensuring they are excluded from the association of the monastic community.
